hardware.label: RTX 5090 / Blackwell
hardware.note: Consumer/workstation Blackwell paths; memory budgets and supported checkpoints differ. DGX Spark has a separate route below.
hardware.note_cn: 桌面／工作站 Blackwell 路径，显存预算与检查点各不相同；DGX Spark 另列。

hardware.label: DGX Spark
hardware.note: Separate single-node Qwen dispatch from the reviewed multi-node full-GLM stack. Advertised additional model paths are not automatically qualified.
hardware.note_cn: 区分单节点 Qwen 调用链与已查多节点完整 GLM 栈；宣传中的其他模型路径不自动视为已核查。

hardware.label: Strix Halo / 395
hardware.note: gfx1151 unified-memory systems. Matching weight files alone does not match quantization, speculation, caching or sampling behavior; Halogen has a closed core.
hardware.note_cn: gfx1151 统一内存设备。同一权重文件不足以统一量化、投机、缓存与采样行为；Halogen 核心闭源。

hardware.label: Apple Silicon
hardware.note: Metal-native execution, SSD expert streaming and ANE compilation are different paths. Chip generations, OS versions and model modifications matter.
hardware.note_cn: Metal 原生执行、SSD 专家流式加载与 ANE 编译是不同路线；须匹配芯片、系统版本与模型改动。

hardware.label: Intel Arc
hardware.note: The reviewed path is tuned on Arc Pro B70; this is not qualification of every Arc device or advertised architecture.
hardware.note_cn: 已查路径以 Arc Pro B70 调优为基础，不代表所有 Arc 设备和宣传架构均已核查。

hardware.label: RTX 3090 / Ampere
hardware.note: Device-specific forks with different model and memory contracts; neither is just an upstream compile-target switch.
hardware.note_cn: 两者都有实际执行改造，但模型和显存契约不同，并非仅切换上游编译目标。

hardware.label: BC-250
hardware.note: A 16 GiB unified-memory offload path. Its default profile drops experts; storage misses remain on the critical path.
hardware.note_cn: 16 GiB 统一内存卸载路径；默认配置削减专家，存储未命中仍会阻塞执行。

hardware.label: Mobile / NPU
hardware.note: CPU, mobile GPU and Hexagon paths have distinct deployment boundaries. Follow the mobile cross-index for reviewed comparisons and platform limitations.
hardware.note_cn: CPU、手机 GPU 和 Hexagon 路径的部署边界不同；移动端交叉索引保留具体对照与平台限制。

models.label: Flash-Next
models.note: Selected Qwen3.8-Flash-Next paths across devices. Formats, reduced precision, cache modes and optional expert/routing changes prevent a speed-only comparison.
models.note_cn: 跨设备的指定 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 路径；权重格式、低精度、缓存模式和可选专家／路由改动需单独比较。

models.label: Other Qwen
models.note: Selected dense and hybrid-MoE checkpoints; family names do not imply interchangeable architectures or unrestricted model loading. Some engines also appear under Flash-Next.
models.note_cn: 指定稠密与混合 MoE 检查点；家族名称不意味着架构可互换或任意权重可加载，部分引擎也列入 Flash-Next。

models.label: GLM-5.3
models.note: The source-reviewed full-GLM cluster path. Newer advertised GLM-Flash and DeepSeek paths are outside this focused review.
models.note_cn: 已做源码核查的完整 GLM 集群路径；新增宣传的 GLM-Flash 和 DeepSeek 路径未纳入本次完整核查。

models.label: Image / video
models.note: Different diffusion model families and runtime boundaries. Verify the exact checkpoint, denoising steps, VAE and approximate cache settings in each record.
models.note_cn: 不同扩散模型家族与运行时边界；应逐项核对检查点、去噪步数、VAE 和近似缓存设置。

models.label: Speech
models.note: Separate speech recognition from synthesis and streaming service behavior. Model families and state ownership are not interchangeable.
models.note_cn: 区分语音识别、语音合成与流式服务；不同模型家族和状态管理方式不能直接互换。
